high_level_description: The image depicts three men standing side by side in front of their respective national flags. The man on the left is wearing a dark suit with a pink tie and is positioned next to the Russian flag. The man in the center is dressed in a traditional Indian kurta-pajama, which is a black outfit with a white shirt underneath, and he is shaking hands with the man on the right. The man on the right is wearing a dark suit with a light blue tie and is positioned next to the Chinese flag.
